clues.title: Google car: Unique car
text: The entire Google car is blurred, but an antenna at the front right can still be seen. It will feel noticeably closer to the car than in other countries with a similar car.
Puerto Rico(Cars there won't have front plates, signs will be Spanish).
Guam (You should be able to see little part of roof rack but as long you will guess NMI or Guam and not Peurto Rico you will get good points)

clues.title: Google car: Close Antenna
text: The entire Google car is blurred, however an antenna at the front right can be seen.
The antenna is also noticeably closer to the camera than in the Guam Google car.
